newsitem.title: GERMANY: AGIV has 1996 breakeven after losses.
newsitem.headline: AGIV has 1996 breakeven after losses.

text.p: German industrial holding company AGIV AG said on Monday it made a pre-tax break-even in 1996 after 44 million marks ($26 million) of losses in 1995.
AGIV added that it was raising its profit forecast for 1997 to 1.50 marks per share from a previous forecast of 1.20 marks.
Stripped of revenues from its stake in the building firm Wayss & Freytag, which it sold late last year, group turnover rose two percent to 6.6 billion marks in 1996, AGIV told a news briefing.
AGIV said the increased earnings per share forecast related to its acquisition of a near 100 percent stake in Austria's Andritz AG, announced earlier.
At the pre-tax level, 1996 profit stood at 40 million marks compared to a loss of 297 million in 1995, AGIV said.
